fixed.climate: dream-midsummer formal garden: warm and sunlit, cooled by fountains (geography.json LOC-rose-tree-yard 'warm and sunlit')

dream_design.rule: WR-010 / XA-magic-08 (dream, full; the dream's goal-image, the purest Mucha space in the film)
dream_design.flora: the white rose-tree is trained into a great rounded crown on a single trunk, its sprays arching in whiplash curves; Madonna lilies stand in the beds with the existing lavender, delphiniums, hollyhocks and sweet peas; roses and clematis climb over curving iron arches along the gravel walks
dream_design.ornament_cues: the rose-tree crown is the halo roundel of the garden and frames the gardeners; the fountains are basins of mosaic and scrolled bronze with water falling in ribbon-curls; the box edging runs in flowing, rounded parterre curves, not straight lines (form and material belong to architecture; the paint-pots and brushes stay 1862 props)
dream_design.palette: white and blush roses, lily white, lavender and powder blue, cream gravel, sage box, fountain aqua, with pale gold light over everything; the wet red paint and the card red are the only saturated notes
dream_design.seasonal_guard: July: roses, Madonna lilies, clematis, lavender and hollyhocks all in flower; no spring bulbs or blossom, no autumn colour (unchanged guard)
dream_design.reason: Beds, fountains and the white rose-tree are explicit (ch007-p105, ch008-p01). WR-010 quotes 'the loveliest garden you ever saw' as the goal-image, so this space carries the language most fully.

fixed.ground_and_flora: bright flower-beds in high-July bloom (designed: lavender, delphiniums, hollyhocks, sweet peas); gravel walks; a large rose-tree in full bloom with white roses, some wet with red paint; the cool fountains beyond; clipped box edging
fixed.dream_growth: Grows from the rose beds and fountains of a grand private garden seen through a small door (cp-garden). After the dark hall, the garden is the late-afternoon sun of the real day at its warmest and kindest: long, golden-white light, the fountains cooling the air. It is the goal-image of the dream.
fixed.seasonal_guard: July is peak rose season, so a full rose-tree in bloom is correct. No spring blossom (no tulips, daffodils or fruit-tree blossom) and no autumn colour.
